title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
abstract: arXiv:2610.26899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. translated_title: 基于大语言模型与强化学习的自主建造与进度更新
translated_abstract: 由于全球人口的快速增长，传统建造方法逐渐无法满足当前的住房需求。机器学习算法的进步促使研究人员探索其在建筑行业中的应用，从而实现更智能、更高效的建造流程。特别是近年来大语言模型的兴起，为传统建造向智能建造的转型提供了更多可能性。本研究提出了一种基于大语言模型与强化学习的自主建造方法。开发了一种增强型软行动者-评论家强化学习算法，可根据建造任务为移动式起重机规划动作。同时利用机器人运动学和控制算法，确保强化学习算法生成的动作能够被起重机实际执行。此外，还提供了一个定制的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种将大语言模型与增强型软行动者-评论家强化学习算法相结合的自主建造方法，使移动式起重机能够根据建造任务自主规划并执行动作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an autonomous construction method combining large language models with an enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm, enabling mobile cranes to autonomously plan and execute actions according to construction tasks.
